scripts.build:blocks: for d in ./blocks/*; do if [ -d "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/src/index.tsx" ]; then if [ ! -f "$d/build/index.js" ] || find "$d/src" -type f -newer "$d/build/index.js" | grep -q .; then (cd "$d" && npx --yes @wordpress/scripts build); fi; fi; done
scripts.build: npm run build:blocks && npm run tailwind:build
scripts.watch:blocks: for d in ./blocks/*; do if [ -d "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/src/index.tsx" ]; then if [ ! -f "$d/build/index.js" ] || find "$d/src" -type f -newer "$d/build/index.js" | grep -q .; then (cd "$d" && npx --yes @wordpress/scripts start); fi; fi; done
scripts.watch: npm run watch:blocks & npm run watch:tailwind
